answer: An agent economy can gate voting and rewards behind proof of scarce compute: each agent must solve a fresh, memory-hard challenge whose kernel is verified on-chain before its stake counts. The challenge seed can combine a nebula beacon with a mesa snapshot, making precomputation and replay ineffective. One operator can still create many identities, but each one must burn real compute and electricity, so splitting into sybils multiplies the attacker’s cost instead of multiplying influence for free.
